body:
/openrx block

Merge closeout is stopped for PR70 at preserved head 35c2cae61092107acb2c684bbca308aca8fb280b. [Independent exact-head review](https://github.com/jliu67/OpenRX/pull/70#pullrequestreview-5518946083) accepts its repaired original-base candidate scope: actual unconditional native/mapped integration executed and all seven head checks passed. It does not accept a combined sibling tree.

After merging approved PR65 and its dependent PR68, main is 5f28dd4363504ecf33a8f10451c53405773c564f. GitHub reports PR70's merge state conflicting/dirty. Its two executor successor hashes also differ from the original hashes strictly pinned by the register-file hashing and scratchpad-finalization drivers inherited from PR65/68. PR70 advances the program-sequence binding helper only; no fresh combined hashing/finalization integration has been validated. Therefore neither conflict resolution nor a merge is attempted in this bounded closeout.

The necessary future action, only when engineering resumes, is to resolve the sibling combination on an isolated branch, preserve old manifests and narrowly declare any intended binding successors, then validate the combined execution/hash/finalization interfaces and applicable regressions on that exact resolved head before merge. No force push, branch deletion, gate relaxation, new local workloads or code changes occurred. Feature branch and all failed/skipped/successful evidence remain preserved. Full-pipeline performance and physical PPA remain unaccepted; the project pause stays in effect.
